data.narrative:
Hidden Level, a Series C-stage defense and security company founded by Jeff Cole and Gary Dominicos, has raised $130M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 13 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage companies, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Quantum-Systems, Helsing, Anduril Industries, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods anchor the analysis. Stage-progression applies a 1.7x multiplier to the $130M raised proxy, implying a valuation of $221M. The peer-median method references 13 Defense & Security peers at Series B through Series D stages; the cohort median valuation stands at $2.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $18.0B. Named peers include Helsing at $18.0B (Series D), Saronic at $9.2B (Series D), Quantum-Systems at $8.0B (Series C), and Chaos Industries at $4.5B (Series D).

The triangulated range is $188M (low), $1.2B (median), and $2.5B (high). The wide spread reflects material variance in peer valuations at comparable stages; stage-progression yields a more conservative floor, while peer medians anchor the mid-to-high range. Key uncertainties include Hidden Level's relative product maturity versus the peer set and the extent to which recent funding inflations in defense tech persist.
